Most affordable M5 MacBook Pro with upgraded 96W Apple charger now $200 off

Amazon bumped the price up $50 on the base model and most affordable current-generation M5 MacBook Pro recently, but B&H has a notable bundle deal that can net you the same machine at $200 off.

B&H is now offering the 14-inch M5 MacBook Pro with 16GB of RAM and the 1TB SSD down at $1,519 shipped.

The base model M5 MacBook Pro carries a $1,699 list price, but B&H is offering this machine today with the official 96W Apple charger – this is worth $20 if you configure this MacBook with the upgraded charger at Apple, leaving the regular list price on the package B&H is offering at $1,719.

While we have tracked this same M5 machined down at $1,499 on Amazon, that offer came with the standard 70W charger instead of the faster 96W Power Adapter B&H is throwing in today – you are effectively saving the same $200 here today as you would have when the Amazon low was live.
